claims_supported: Authorization verifies that an action is approved for a specific entity and is distinct from authentication.
RBAC grants access through assigned roles; ABAC uses subject/object/environment attributes and policies; ReBAC uses relationships.
Least privilege, deny-by-default, per-request checks and server-side enforcement are recommended.
ABAC and ReBAC should typically be preferred over RBAC, which remains simpler to set up.
limitations: Advisory cheat sheet, not a standard.
